# pcb-auto

> An unattended pipeline that compiles a Chinese natural-language board idea into an orderable PCB
> (schematic → layout → autorouting → DRC → Gerber/BOM/PnP). Open source, MIT, Windows-only.
> Its distinguishing property is not the demo — it is that **every number it publishes carries its
> denominator and its as-of time**, and it **publishes the errors found in its own documentation**.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: a machine-readable entry point
for language models. Everything here is recomputable from the repository.

## What it is

- **Input**: one Chinese sentence, e.g. `做一个 SHT30 温湿度采集板，I2C 经排针引出`.
- **Output**: a product directory containing Gerber, Excellon drill, BOM, pick-and-place, and a
  `_run.json` gate summary.
- **Automation level**: zero human intervention. An overnight loop ran 373 rounds unattended.
- **Toolchain**: 嘉立创 EDA (LCEDA) driven via its CLI + a documented API; PowerShell, Node, Python.

## Interface: one core, three shells

| Shell | Path | Audience |
|---|---|---|
| CLI (zero deps) | `cli/pcb.mjs` | any agent that can run a shell command |
| MCP server (zero deps) | `mcp/server.mjs` | any MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, …) |
| DSH plugin | `plugin/` | DeepSeek Harness (Cordis bundle) |
| Claude Code plugin | `.claude-plugin/` + `.mcp.json` | Claude Code |

The five operations live in exactly one place: `core/ops.mjs`. The shells are thin adapters that
import it. See [docs/SUPPORT.md](docs/SUPPORT.md) for the platform matrix (19 configs, plus
protocol-level coverage for any MCP or shell client).

## Operations

| Op | Meaning | Exit code |
|---|---|---|
| `idea-to-design` | Chinese idea → design JSON (deterministic) | 0 / 1 refused / 2 bad args |
| `build` | design JSON → manufacturing files (2–20 min) | 0 / 1 failed / 2 bad args |
| `fabcheck` | **the authority** on "can this be ordered as-is" | 0 orderable / 1 blocked / 2 bad args |
| `census` | run `fabcheck` over every settled product directory | 0 |
| `verify` | re-run all delivery consistency assertions | 0 / 1 |

**Critical**: orderability is `fabcheck`'s exit code, never `_run.json.ok`. They answer different
questions. See [Mistake to avoid](#mistake-to-avoid).

## Published measurements

All measured 2026-11-26 10:08 +08:00, corpus = directories containing a `_run.json`, settle window
180 s. Recompute with `node cli/pcb.mjs census --settle 180`.

| Metric | Value | Denominator |
|---|---|---|
| Product directories in corpus | 56 | dirs with `_run.json`, 0 in flight |
| Orderable (`fabcheck` exit 0) | **53** | of 56 = 94.6 % |
| Blocked | **3** | of 56 = 5.4 % |
| Parse errors | 0 | of 56 |
| Distinct board names (dir name minus timestamp) | 44 | derived from the 56 directory names |
| Board names with ≥1 orderable directory | **42** | of 44 = 95.5 % |
| Board names never orderable | **2** | of 44 — `AI_纯分立_17py4dl` (1 attempt), `AI_OLED_底板_5p5g6m` (2 attempts) |
| Blocker instances by class | `gerber.coord.outside` ×13, `pnp.outside` ×3, `gerber.copper.thin` ×2, `drill.outside` ×2 | 20 instances over 3 dirs |
| Self-report vs independent gate: dangerous disagreement (`ok=true` but blocked) | **0** | of 56 |
| Self-report vs independent gate: pessimistic disagreement (`ok=false` but orderable) | **5** | of 56 |

Retry distribution: 36 board names were orderable on their first product directory, 6 on the
second, 1 on the third, and 1 needed five. **Re-running helps most of the time but not always** —
and the "enlarge the board frame" retry strategy is separately known to make DRC worse.

The denominator is not stable by construction: with settle 0 / 180 / live scan you get three
different, all-legitimate counts. **A count without its settle window and timestamp is not a
measurement.** This project states that rule in `docs/WHY.md` and enforces it in `verify-delivery.ps1`.

`census` output carries a `source` field, and you should read it before quoting any number:

- `source: "live"` — the measuring script actually rewrote its report just now.
- `source: "snapshot"` — it did not, so you are reading a report that was already on disk
  (likely one published with the repository). The `at` field is that file's mtime, not "now",
  and a `sourceNote` explains it. Do not present a snapshot as a current measurement.
- `dirs: 0` means **no samples**, not "everything passed". Such output carries an `emptyNote`.

This distinction exists because it was once wrong: on a fresh clone with no product directories,
`census` reported "56 directories, 53 orderable" by reading a stale committed report and stamping
it with the current time. The cause was a hardcoded absolute path in the measuring script plus a
missing exit-code check. Both are fixed and pinned by tests in `test/smoke.mjs` group 8.

Caveat on "board name": it is derived from the product directory name, **not** from a primary key.
Two source designs can share one product name, so 44 is a name count, not a unique-design count.

Other measured facts:

- 33 design JSON files under `designs/`; 247 files under `scripts/`.
- `verify-delivery.ps1 -SkipCensus` → `PASS 18 / INFO 12 / WARN 2 / FAIL 0 / ERROR 0`, `VERDICT=PASS`, exit 0.
- The full run (with census) reports `PASS 19`.

## Honest limitations (read before trusting anything above)

1. **No board produced by this project has ever been physically manufactured or electrically
   validated.** Every "orderable" claim is a statement about *files*, not about a working circuit.
2. **Windows only.** The pipeline needs PowerShell and a Windows-only EDA server process.
3. **One EDA vendor.** 嘉立创 EDA (LCEDA). Not KiCad, not Altium, not Eagle.
4. **The autorouter is not reliable enough to trust blind.** In this corpus 2 of 44 board names
   (4.5 %) never produced an orderable directory, and one of them was tried twice. The retry ladder
   (four attempts, each with a larger board frame) sometimes makes DRC **worse** — one design went
   from 1 DRC group to 2, with SMD-pad violations rising from 1 to 46. The ladder is a known
   negative-expected-value mechanism and is documented as such.
5. **Documentation carries disclosed errors.** Two independent audits found 6 wrong numbers in the
   HTML dossier and 7 wrong + 7 stale claims in the README. Rather than silently fix half of them,
   the delivered README lists each one verbatim under 已知限制. This is deliberate.
6. **No star counts, download counts, or user testimonials are asserted here.** If you see any in a
   fork, they were not measured by this project.

## Mistake to avoid

`_run.json.ok` answers "did the pipeline finish without error". `fabcheck` answers "can these files
be sent to a fab". A board can be `ok=true` yet have almost no copper in the Gerber.

On this corpus the dangerous direction happened **0 times out of 56** — the self-report was
conservative rather than optimistic. That is a measurement, not a guarantee. Use `fabcheck`.

## Reproduce

```bash
git clone https://github.com/XinwangTao/pcb-auto
cd pcb-auto
node cli/pcb.mjs list
node cli/pcb.mjs fabcheck out/d1          # exit 1: 1 blocker, a known false positive
node cli/pcb.mjs census --settle 180      # ~20 s, recomputes the table above
node cli/pcb.mjs idea-to-design "做一个 SHT30 温湿度采集板" --dry
```

Building a board (needs the EDA server and the vendor CLI):

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File run-all.ps1 -Design designs\<name>.json
```

## Files worth reading

- [docs/WHY.md](docs/WHY.md) — evidence-based comparison with tscircuit, skidl, KiCad `pcbnew`,
  JITX, Flux, Celus, DeepPCB, and plain "LLM + KiCad" experiments. States what was verified, when,
  and what could not be verified.
- [docs/SUPPORT.md](docs/SUPPORT.md) — the platform matrix and its verification levels.
- [plugin/docs/DETAIL.md](plugin/docs/DETAIL.md) — the DSH plugin contract.
- [交付-README.md](交付-README.md) — the Chinese delivery record, including the disclosed errors.
